purpose: Select an internal DEV50 validation architecture that reduces correlated-event overcounting before rerunning Defensive GA.
diagnostic_answer_key: already-consumed preserved50+TEST17 outcomes for PF1-PF5; answer key may evaluate methods only after DEV50-only method scores are fixed
experimental_unit_principle: Ticker/date events are observations, not automatically independent successes. Market episode and synchronized-date clusters are primary dependence units.

methods.description: Equal-weight normalized cross-sectional composite path by session/episode. Evaluate whether finalist-selected opportunities have aggregate directional/economic support without multiplying credit by ticker count.
Weight same-date selected events so each date contributes approximately one evidentiary unit; report episode-balanced performance so long episodes do not dominate.
Deterministic five-fold ticker cross-validation on DEV50. Score each frozen finalist separately in every held-out stock fold; emphasize worst-fold and dispersion rather than pooled event count.

Leave-one-bear-episode-out stability diagnostic. Because finalists are already frozen, measure contribution/stability across six independent historical environments and penalize dependence on one episode.
Combine stock-fold stability, episode balance, and same-date cluster weighting. No component may earn extra evidence merely from more correlated trades.

deterministic_stock_fold_rule: sort exact DEV50 ticker symbols lexicographically and assign round-robin fold index 0..4
method_evaluation_rule: First compute all method metrics from DEV50 only. Freeze those outputs. Then compare method warnings/rankings to known PF1-PF5 50+17 transport. Prefer methods that would reject or downgrade nonportable finalists without requiring knowledge of replay-specific numeric cutoffs and that preserve materially more support for the relatively more portable PF1.
no_arbitrary_pass_threshold: This tournament diagnoses which validation architecture is informative. It does not choose a trading pass/fail threshold from the answer key.
next_step_if_successful: Freeze selected validation architecture and its future acceptance rule before rerunning GA on DEV50; only then verify frozen finalists on preserved50 and test on TEST17.
